je_pmr_analytical_philosophy_inception = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	possible = { can_research = analytical_philosophy }

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_analytical_philosophy

	complete = {
		scope:journal_entry ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_analytical_philosophy)" >= 36 }
	}

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = analytical_philosophy }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 8750  technology = analytical_philosophy }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_analytical_philosophy  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
			debug_log = "PMR_JEH|inception|analytical_philosophy|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = analytical_philosophy  NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_pmr_analytical_philosophy_development } }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_analytical_philosophy_development }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|inception|analytical_philosophy|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = analytical_philosophy }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_analytical_philosophy_implementation = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_analytical_philosophy

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_analytical_philosophy_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_analytical_philosophy)" >= 36 } }
				if = {
					limit = { can_research = analytical_philosophy }
					add_technology_progress = { progress = 8750  technology = analytical_philosophy }
				}
						if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_analytical_philosophy  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|analytical_philosophy|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_analytical_philosophy }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_analytical_philosophy  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_analytical_philosophy  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_analytical_philosophy')|0]|analytical_philosophy|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_analytical_philosophy_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_analytical_philosophy } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = analytical_philosophy
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_analytical_philosophy  var:pmr_impl_analytical_philosophy >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_art_silk

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_art_silk_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_art_silk)" >= 36 } }
				if = {
					limit = { can_research = art_silk }
					add_technology_progress = { progress = 7500  technology = art_silk }
				}
						if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_art_silk  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|art_silk|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_art_silk }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_art_silk  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_art_silk  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_art_silk')|0]|art_silk|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_art_silk_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_art_silk } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = art_silk
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_art_silk  var:pmr_impl_art_silk >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

		}

				je:je_pmr_behaviorism_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_behaviorism } }

je_pmr_combustion_engine_implementation = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_combustion_engine

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_combustion_engine_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_combustion_engine)" >= 36 } }
				if = {
					limit = { can_research = combustion_engine }
					add_technology_progress = { progress = 7500  technology = combustion_engine }
				}
						if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_combustion_engine  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|combustion_engine|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_combustion_engine }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_combustion_engine  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_combustion_engine  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_combustion_engine')|0]|combustion_engine|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_combustion_engine_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_combustion_engine } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = combustion_engine
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_combustion_engine  var:pmr_impl_combustion_engine >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no

				}
								if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_feminism }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_feminism  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_feminism  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_feminism')|0]|feminism|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_feminism_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_feminism } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = feminism
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_feminism  var:pmr_impl_feminism >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no

				je:je_pmr_joint_stock_companies_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_joint_stock_companies } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = joint_stock_companies
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_joint_stock_companies  var:pmr_impl_joint_stock_companies >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_mechanical_tools_implementation = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_mechanical_tools

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_mechanical_tools_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_mechanical_tools)" >= 36 } }
				if = {
					limit = { can_research = mechanical_tools }
					add_technology_progress = { progress = 5000  technology = mechanical_tools }
				}
						if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_mechanical_tools  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|mechanical_tools|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_mechanical_tools }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_mechanical_tools  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_mechanical_tools  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_mechanical_tools')|0]|mechanical_tools|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_mechanical_tools_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_mechanical_tools } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = mechanical_tools
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_mechanical_tools  var:pmr_impl_mechanical_tools >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

			}

			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_radio_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_radio)" >= 36 } }
				if = {
					limit = { can_research = radio }
					add_technology_progress = { progress = 7500  technology = radio }
				}
						if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_radio  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|radio|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_radio }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_radio  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_radio  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_radio')|0]|radio|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_radio_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_radio } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = radio
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_radio  var:pmr_impl_radio >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

	group = je_group_technology

			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_rubber_mastication_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_rubber_mastication)" >= 36 } }
				if = {

					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|rubber_mastication|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_rubber_mastication }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_rubber_mastication  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_rubber_mastication  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_rubber_mastication')|0]|rubber_mastication|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_rubber_mastication_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_rubber_mastication } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {

			has_technology_researched = rubber_mastication
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_rubber_mastication  var:pmr_impl_rubber_mastication >= 18 }
		}

			limit = { can_research = telephone }
			add_technology_progress = { progress = 7500  technology = telephone }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_telephone  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
			debug_log = "PMR_JEH|development|telephone|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
		}
		if = {
			limit = { can_research = telephone  NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_pmr_telephone_implementation } }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_pmr_telephone_implementation }
		}
		debug_log = "PMR_JE|development|telephone|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
	}

	invalid = { has_technology_researched = telephone }

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

je_pmr_telephone_implementation = {
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	group = je_group_technology

	scripted_progress_bar = pmr_bar_telephone

	on_monthly_pulse = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { je:je_pmr_telephone_implementation ?= { "scripted_bar_progress(pmr_bar_telephone)" >= 36 } }
				if = {
					limit = { can_research = telephone }
					add_technology_progress = { progress = 7500  technology = telephone }
				}
						if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = pmr_held_telephone  NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism } }
					debug_log = "PMR_JEH|implementation|telephone|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
				}
						if = { limit = { has_variable = pmr_impl_telephone }  change_variable = { name = pmr_impl_telephone  add = 1 } }
				else = { set_variable = { name = pmr_impl_telephone  value = 1 } }
				debug_log = "PMR_JE|implementation[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_implv_telephone')|0]|telephone|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]"
				je:je_pmr_telephone_implementation ?= { add_progress = { value = -36  name = pmr_bar_telephone } }
			}
		}
	}

	invalid = {
		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = telephone
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_telephone  var:pmr_impl_telephone >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}

		OR = {
			has_technology_researched = watertube_boiler
			AND = { has_variable = pmr_impl_watertube_boiler  var:pmr_impl_watertube_boiler >= 18 }
		}
	}

	weight = 1
	transferable = no
	can_revolution_inherit = yes
	should_be_pinned_by_default_uninvolved_or_context = no
}
